GraceRequirements.Annotation: Single-user, channel-aware media analysis platform. API-owned product state is shared by Telegram, Web, MCP, and future adapters.
GraceRequirements.Keywords: media_asset, stored_object, collection, inbox, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, analysis_run_step, analysis_run_step_input, artifact, artifact_subject, diagnostic, export_job, metadata_enrichment_job, channel_account, channel_surface, operation_request, copperasr

Goals.Goal: Accept text, URL, file, image, audio, voice, video, and document inputs through one channel-account-scoped API ingestion boundary.

Keep immutable selection and analysis lifecycle state in the API while workers execute claimed steps and publish artifacts and diagnostics; queue-specific fencing is required only where the current contracts implement it.
Provide provider-agnostic Telegram and Web experiences plus explicit MCP access to API-owned materials, runs, artifacts, and diagnostics.

Users.User: One human user operating through Telegram, Web, MCP, or another channel adapter.

CanonicalVocabulary.Term: media_asset is a durable API-owned occurrence of user-provided text, URL, file, image, audio, voice, video, or document material.
stored_object records managed bytes or origin metadata, checksum, size, MIME type, publication generation, and retention state behind a media_asset or artifact.
collection groups ordered media_asset references; inbox is the default collection for each channel_account.
selection_snapshot is an immutable ordered copy of selected material references, options, execution metadata, creator, timestamps, and validation diagnostics.
analysis_run is the user-visible lifecycle; analysis_run_step and analysis_run_step_input are internal worker execution records.
artifact and artifact_subject record durable outputs, access metadata, retention state, and lineage to runs, steps, snapshots, items, media assets, or diagnostics.
export_job is a fenced one-media operation independent from collection and analysis_run lifecycle.
object_pin is a transactional protected reference that prevents deletion scheduling while work or delivery needs an available stored_object.

ModelChain.Rule: media_asset to collection/inbox to immutable selection_snapshot to analysis_run to analysis_run_step/artifact to artifact_subject lineage is the canonical analysis chain.
media_asset to export_job to transient delivery object is independent and never mutates collection membership or analysis_run state.
Adapters create and organize materials before execution; transient submission modes are not the product model.

AccessScope.Rule: Telegram chat/user, Web account/session, and MCP caller identities resolve to channel_account at the API boundary.
All media, collection, snapshot, run, artifact, diagnostic, retention, idempotency, cursor, version, and channel-surface decisions are channel-account-scoped.
No owner, workspace, workspace-member, or alternate caller-scope product entity is introduced without a real multi-user requirement.

LifecycleStatuses.AnalysisRun: queued, claiming, running, succeeded, partially_succeeded, failed, cancel_requested, canceled, expired.
LifecycleStatuses.ExportJob: queued, claimed, running, cancel_requested, succeeded, failed, canceled, expired.

Requirement.Action: Create media_asset records from Telegram, Web, MCP, and server-side imports through one API-owned ingestion boundary.
Requirement.Acceptance: Accept text, URL, generic file, photo/image, audio/voice, video, and document inputs; record channel scope, stored object or origin, hash when available, size, MIME type, adapter origin, creation time, validation, retention, and diagnostics.

Requirement.Action: Separate user-visible material occurrences from physical byte identity.
Requirement.Acceptance: Stream uploads to managed staging while computing SHA-256 and size; deduplicate physical identity by channel_account_id, sha256, and size_bytes independently of filename; fence publication, losing-upload cleanup, collision rejection, and expired-body re-upload. Preserve separate media_asset occurrences and derive liveness from references and pins, not a refcount.

Requirement.Action: Enrich supported remote references without persisting provider media.
Requirement.Acceptance: Canonical YouTube ingestion atomically creates one idempotent metadata_enrichment_job independent from exports and runs. Claims, heartbeats, backoff, max attempts, and finalization are attempt-token fenced; sanitized bounded title, thumbnail URL, duration, and performer metadata may update only current media_asset display metadata. Public refresh is channel-scoped, internal routes require platform token, sealed snapshots stay immutable, and API performs no provider network call.

Requirement.Action: Maintain inbox and named collections independently from execution.
Requirement.Acceptance: Every channel account has a default inbox; callers can list, create, rename, archive, delete, and reorder with scope and optimistic version checks. Accepted material appends to the next active position without duplicate active positions.

Requirement.Action: Create immutable selection_snapshots from explicit ordered media_asset references.
Requirement.Acceptance: Validate channel access, availability, options, ordering, duplicates, and limits; copy item IDs and execution metadata, options, creator, timestamps, and validation diagnostics into the stored snapshot.

Requirement.Action: Create analysis_run records only from selection_snapshots.
Requirement.Acceptance: Record snapshot, channel scope, run type, delivery preference, queued state, idempotency key, evidence-gate state, diagnostics channel, planned steps, and step inputs; keep execution rows out of the public product surface.

Requirement.Action: Atomically launch processing from exact current collection membership.
Requirement.Acceptance: One transaction validates channel and expected collection version, pins available objects, seals the snapshot, creates run and steps, and removes exactly captured memberships. Later arrivals remain; terminal delivery never clears them. Failed/canceled work can retry from the immutable run/snapshot or be explicitly restored.

Requirement.Action: Plan prerequisites in the API before workers execute.
Requirement.Acceptance: Build combined transcription inputs from original text, reusable transcripts, and missing speech; declare ready transcript_artifact inputs and leave only missing speech for ASR. Report/deep-research work requires or plans ready text prerequisites. Missing, failed, or unavailable prerequisites record stable analysis_prerequisite_* diagnostics and visible terminal status.

Requirement.Action: Use CopperASR as the only active speech transcription backend.
Requirement.Acceptance: Workers call the dedicated CopperASR HTTP runtime, publish transcript_plain, transcript_segmented_markdown, transcript_docx, run_manifest, and run_diagnostics, keep provider metadata in service artifacts, map stable asr_* failures, include inline and text/* object inputs directly, and avoid ASR for text-only selections. Unreadable text records item failure; legacy ASR code, switches, caches, dependencies, and fallback tests stay absent.

Requirement.Action: Reuse ready transcript artifacts instead of retranscribing known speech.
Requirement.Acceptance: A scoped terminal single-source transcript can be delivered immediately without a new snapshot/run. Mixed selections convert precise reusable speech to transcript_artifact inputs, retain missing speech for ASR, preserve text inputs and snapshot order, and reject ambiguous multi-item lineage. Restart-safe delivery deduplication must not block explicit resend after new duplicate input.

Requirement.Action: Cancel analysis runs through a cooperative API-owned lifecycle.
Requirement.Acceptance: Queued unclaimed work becomes canceled and stops; claimed work becomes cancel_requested for worker observation, stops unclaimed tasks, and forces late finalization to canceled rather than succeeded or failed.

Requirement.Action: Create one-material export jobs independently from collection processing.
Requirement.Acceptance: YouTube audio/video and uploaded video-to-audio use scoped idempotency, immutable profiles, bounded retries, expiring leases, attempt tokens, progress, process-group cancellation, diagnostics, lineage, delivery claim/ack/failure, and short-lived output objects. Telegram validates current membership without coupling this non-mutating action to an unchanged collection version; the API enforces current channel scope and asset availability. YouTube audio waits for stable provider title and performer metadata, and assets missing performer metadata are re-enriched before creation. New audio profiles support 64/96/128/192/256/320 kbps M4A/AAC native music cards; existing OGG/Opus profiles remain deliverable as voice, including application/ogg. Reject MIME/filename mismatch, fence stale/canceled publication, hold source pins through active work, reacquire only available sources on retry, and never mutate collection or analysis-run lifecycle.

Requirement.Action: Expose artifacts as analysis_run outputs with API-governed preview and download metadata.
Requirement.Acceptance: Transcript, summary, report, structured data, source manifest, execution log, and diagnostic bundles record channel scope, run, kind, content type, size, checksum, stored object, visibility, retention, preview metadata, and artifact_subject lineage.

Requirement.Action: Preserve rejected and partially processed facts as diagnostics.
Requirement.Acceptance: Ingestion, selection, run, adapter, worker, artifact, cancellation, retention, and permission failures expose stable codes, readable messages, safe context, correlation IDs, timestamps, and remediation hints.

Requirement.Action: Apply retention consistently across objects, media, selections, runs, artifacts, diagnostics, and deleted membership.
Requirement.Acceptance: MEDIA_OBJECT_RETENTION_DAYS is positive and defaults to seven; each generation expires from max(generation_published_at,last_successful_use_at). Workload and delivery pins release on terminal/ack/TTL rules; active holds block delete scheduling, delete_scheduled blocks access, and the sweeper uses owner/token/lease, bounded retry, idempotent deletion, and managed-prefix reconciliation without orphaning run history.

Requirement.Action: Treat worker filesystem materialization as bounded attempt-scoped scratch space.
Requirement.Acceptance: Ingress uses disk-backed transfer files; workers stream S3 objects in bounded chunks into sanitized attempt-token workspaces, remove partial transfers and workspaces in outer finally, reap abandoned heartbeat-aware workspaces, bound resources, and expose cleanup failure without changing terminal product results.

Requirement.Action: Keep Telegram, Web, and MCP thin adapters over the same API-owned state.
Requirement.Acceptance: Telegram follows collection membership, uses Russian-first explicit actions, immediately delivers results, and records result_artifact_surface deduplication. Web uses simple human wording and hides internal names outside debug views. MCP may expose technical vocabulary in its tool contract. Adapters never own durable product semantics.

Requirement.Action: Run report and research analysis from prepared transcript or text-corpus artifacts.
Requirement.Acceptance: Agent-runner consumes declared ready artifacts and safe metadata, publishes report/research outputs through analysis_run, and records prerequisite diagnostics instead of transcribing or processing raw speech itself.

Requirement.Action: Persist external interaction surfaces without consumer-specific fields on domain entities.
Requirement.Acceptance: Channel surfaces store scoped channel, type, key, opaque address/fingerprint/display state, lifecycle, version, and timestamps; subject links are separate and event history append-only. Display state cannot alter media, collection, snapshot, run, artifact, or diagnostic lifecycle.

Constraints.Constraint: channel_account is the only product access scope; reject cross-account reads and writes before storage mutation.
analysis_run records are created only from immutable selection_snapshots; collection changes never mutate an existing snapshot or run.
CopperASR is the only active ASR backend; provider calls stay inside the transcription worker boundary.
Current local database data is disposable for target reset/rebuild; do not preserve or backfill legacy rows except the approved metadata-only YouTube enrichment path.
Retain diagnostics for rejected and partial work, and fence leases, retries, cancellation, publication, and delivery against stale workers.
Public list envelopes use arrays, including empty collections and pages; internal execution rows remain behind the API product surface.

DeletedArchitecture.Rule: Removed implementation-era product names may appear only in historical deletion evidence or negative regression checks, never active contracts, flows, or new documentation.
Do not restore legacy jobs/project/source-item/source-artifact product entities, dual ASR backends, Telegram-owned lifecycle, or broad media inventory as inbox truth.

Telegram.Rule: Accept messages, files, URLs, media groups, inline commands, and Bot API video_note round-video messages as management/input gestures over the current inbox; video_note follows the same upload, selection, and transcription path as regular video.

After accepted input, show current inbox or collection state and explicit selection/run actions. Callback mutations address API-owned media_asset, collection, selection_snapshot, and analysis_run identities with versions where required.

Keep background active-run state separate from the current material selection. A current selection may start another run unless the card is focused on an active run; cancellation targets the focused active run or the latest visible active run by id and version.

Active processing cards show user-facing duration, the current stage derived from analysis_run events, and elapsed time without provider internals, raw worker progress stages, VAD details, or ASR timings.

Main-card diagnostics stay scoped to the run launched from that card. Historical terminal runs do not create generic result actions for a new or unstarted selection; successful results are delivered automatically as files.

Processing launch removes exactly the captured collection membership in the atomic snapshot/run transaction. Result success or failure never clears the live inbox, so materials accepted during execution remain available.

Persist message mappings only through opaque channel surfaces. A presentation refresh or surface-persistence failure after successful ingest must not turn the saved mutation into a backend failure; confirm the saved material, offer /inbox recovery, and log the presentation failure.

Reuse the editable active current_materials_panel for a same-scope inbound burst and serialize refreshes. A new burst after the configured window creates one fresh nearby panel and edits that panel for the remainder of the burst.

When download is required before API ingest, create or edit a visible pending card from Telegram message metadata before transfer completes, then transform that same card into the normal current_materials_panel after successful ingest.

Compose-owned large-media ingestion uses a local Telegram Bot API server with TELEGRAM_API_ID and TELEGRAM_API_HASH, a persistent telegram-bot-api-data volume, and read-only volume sharing when local-mode file paths are absolute.
For a single uploaded material, query API-owned reusable-transcript state by stored-object identity before creating a run. A matched transcript is delivered as a fresh document for the new action.

After delivering a result artifact, publish the current_materials_panel after that result, rebind the stable panel surface, retire the previous processing card best-effort, and supersede the terminal analysis_task_surface. Restart recovery preserves or recreates the panel and retires predecessor terminal task cards without implying a restarted run. A terminal edit throttle or failure must not leave the only current control card above the delivered result.
Mixed selections rely on API-owned run planning for partial transcript reuse; Telegram does not infer reusable subsets from Telegram file identity or mutable inbox state.

Material rows expose Скачать plus Убрать for YouTube references and В аудио plus Убрать for uploaded video. The main card shows the same shortcut only for exactly one eligible material, while Обработать remains primary.
Export actions create API-owned export jobs and export_task_surface state without removing collection membership, clearing the current materials card, or changing analysis-run focus.

Choose export presentation from authenticated download MIME: audio/ogg and audio/opus use send_voice, other audio types use send_audio for compatibility, and non-audio output uses send_document unless an approved change defines another native presentation.

Represent current panels, active-run cards, and delivered results as current_materials_panel, analysis_task_surface, and result_artifact_surface. Recovery may restore or recreate them but never mutate product lifecycle through them.
Active channel-surface listing honors subject_type and subject_id filters so control/task surfaces cannot be mistaken for delivered result-artifact surfaces.

Resolve chat/user scope to channel_account and use target public API calls for media, collection membership, snapshots, runs, artifacts, and diagnostics. Repeated resolution returns the persisted channel-account id from the API conflict path before create/upload references it.

Web.Rule: Provide a simple human-facing surface for browsing materials, creating groups, curating selection, launching analysis, and reviewing progress, results, errors, and downloads.

Use the target public API while keeping internal terms, opaque ids, manifests, and diagnostic internals out of normal copy. In particular, media_asset, selection_snapshot, analysis_run_step, channel_surface, Run builder, Artifacts, Diagnostics, Run manifest, Analysis run, Media item, raw ids, and diagnostic internals must not become load-bearing labels outside explicit admin/debug views.
Render enriched title, thumbnail, duration, contextual export actions, semantic quality choices, export progress, cancellation, and authenticated downloads over the same API used by Telegram.

Mcp.Rule: Expose create_media_asset, list_media_assets, search_media_assets, get_media_asset, delete_media_asset, get_inbox, create_collection, list_collections, get_collection, update_collection, update_collection_items, create_selection_snapshot, get_selection_snapshot, run_analysis, list_runs, get_run, cancel_run, retry_run, list_run_events, list_artifacts, get_artifact, get_artifact_preview, refresh_artifact, and get_diagnostics.
Technical vocabulary is allowed in this tool-contract context, but MCP owns no separate durable media or lifecycle state.

AdapterBoundaries.SharedRule: All adapters create, read, and mutate durable product state through API contracts and cannot call CopperASR or provider metadata endpoints directly.

EvidenceGates.Gate: Requirements, architecture, contracts, storage, API, workers, adapters, security/operations, deterministic fixtures, coverage inventory, no-legacy checks, runtime compose proof, and staleness/closure evidence are separate gates.
Historical successful evidence is provenance only. Fresh completion requires rerunning the commands routed from .grace/verification and recording exact outcomes.
Architecture, coverage, and readiness evidence belongs in context and verification policy rather than in implementation-module identities.

BeadsTrace.Rule: Current and follow-up work is tracked with bd; completed legacy execution packets remain in the external backup and Git history and are not converted to retroactive C-* bundles.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Multi-user workspaces, owners, members, or team authorization.
Provider-owned product lifecycle or channel-specific product tables.
General legacy data preservation during the disposable local target rebuild.
Reintroducing legacy ASR fallback or exposing provider internals in normal Telegram/Web presentation.
